mapper.select: SELECT fields::text,version,moderation_status FROM profile_drafts WHERE account_id=#{id}

SELECT jsonb_build_object('nickname',p.nickname,'bio',p.bio,'regionCode',p.region_code,'avatarMediaId',p.avatar_media_id,'interestIds',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(interest_id ORDER BY interest_id) FROM profile_interests WHERE account_id=p.account_id),'[]'::jsonb))::text AS fields,p.version,p.moderation_status FROM profiles p WHERE p.account_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile_drafts(account_id,fields,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},CAST(#{fields} AS jsonb),#{version},#{now},#{now}) ON CONFLICT(account_id) DO UPDATE SET fields=EXCLUDED.fields,version=EXCLUDED.version,moderation_status='pending',updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT code,parent_code,level,name_ja,name_zh FROM regions WHERE code=#{code} AND active=true
SELECT code,parent_code,level,name_ja,name_zh FROM regions WHERE active=true AND ((#{parentCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL AND level='prefecture') OR parent_code=#{parentCode}) ORDER BY code
SELECT id,code,name_zh FROM interests WHERE id=#{id} AND active=true
SELECT id,code,name_zh FROM interests WHERE active=true ORDER BY sort_order,code
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM profiles p JOIN accounts a ON a.id=p.account_id WHERE p.account_id=#{id} AND p.visibility='public' AND p.moderation_status='approved' AND a.status='active')

SELECT #{viewer} != #{target} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM blocks WHERE (blocker_id=#{viewer} AND blocked_id=#{target}) OR (blocker_id=#{target} AND blocked_id=#{viewer})) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_settings WHERE account_id=#{target} AND (allow_stranger_dm OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM direct_contact_states WHERE ((account_low_id=#{viewer} AND account_high_id=#{target}) OR (account_low_id=#{target} AND account_high_id=#{viewer})) AND low_sent_count>0 AND high_sent_count>0)))
SELECT status,declared_at,withdrawn_at FROM age_declarations WHERE account_id=#{id} AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now})
